text:
rachel (People Ops): Quick question for benefits folks: I'm planning an unpaid sabbatical 2028-09-01 to 2028-11-30. I have a live 401(k) loan with Horizon. Two things: 1) Can I pause contributions and resume on return? 2) What happens to loan repayments during the unpaid period and any risk of an auto-offset/taxable distribution? Any paperwork deadlines?

tom-payroll: Short answer: you can change deferral to 0% before your last paid paycheck. Changes must be entered in Workday by the payroll cutoff (two business days before run). If there's no pay, we can't deduct employee deferrals.

elaine-hr: Employer match only applies to paid payroll periods; unpaid sabbatical pauses match. Vesting doesn't change. Submit LOA approval to benefits@redwood.com so we have it on file.

dexter (Horizon Retirement): Hi rachel 1 Horizon here. Loan repayments stop when there's no payroll to collect from. For short sabbaticals we usually document a suspension so the loan remains active. If a loan becomes delinquent per plan rules or the employee separates, the plan may offset the outstanding balance and treat it as a distribution (taxable and reported on a 1099-R). To avoid surprises, have benefits@redwood.com notify us with LOA dates and include loan ID + last 4 SSN.

rachel (People Ops): If I want to "make up" missed deferrals after I return, is that possible?

tom-payroll: You can't pull money out of past paychecks. You can increase future deferral %, up to IRS limits, to accelerate savings, but it's forward-looking only. If you're close to the annual deferral cap, contact benefits so we can run numbers.

benefits-bot: Reminder: 401(k) deferral change deadline is 17:00 PT two business days before payroll. LOA doc upload: https://intranet.redwood/hr/leave-upload

dexter (Horizon Retirement): Recommended email template to loans@horizonret.com:

Subject: LOA - Rachel S - request loan suspension - 2028-09-01 to 2028-11-30
Body: attach LOA approval PDF, include Loan ID and last 4 SSN. We'll confirm suspension and proposed restart date.

rachel (People Ops): Thanks all 1 I'll file LOA and ping benefits/payroll once submitted. Appreciate the help :pray:
